import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load the imported Curio dataset
df = curio_load_data("imported.x4ea95d311315")

# Copy the dataset
df = df.copy()

# Group by route and individual CTA stop
group_cols = ["Route", "Stop-CTA ID"]

# Measurement columns
measurement_cols = [
    "Actual Next (in Mins)",
    "Observation Next (in Mins), Based on Ventra App",
    "Observation Previous (in mins)"
]

# Clean and impute each measurement independently
for col in measurement_cols:

    # Convert to numeric
    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

    # Replace 999 with NaN
    df[col] = df[col].replace(999, np.nan)

    # Calculate median within each route-stop group
    group_median = df.groupby(group_cols)[col].transform("median")

    # Fill missing values using group median
    df[col] = df[col].fillna(group_median)

# Calculate deviation from the 10-minute target
df["Headway Deviation"] = (
    df["Actual Next (in Mins)"] - 10
)

# Classify headway status
df["Headway Status"] = np.select(
    [
        df["Actual Next (in Mins)"].isna(),
        df["Actual Next (in Mins)"] < 10,
        df["Actual Next (in Mins)"] == 10,
        df["Actual Next (in Mins)"] > 10
    ],
    [
        "Missing",
        "Below Target",
        "On Target",
        "Above Target"
    ],
    default="Missing"
)

# Return cleaned dataset to Curio

# Prepare data in the structure expected by the original Vega-Lite spec

def safe_value(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return None
    if hasattr(value, "isoformat"):
        return value.isoformat()
    return value

def clean_id(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return ""
    result = str(value)
    if result.endswith(".0"):
        result = result[:-2]
    return result

stop_records = []

group_cols_for_stops = [
    "Route",
    "Stop-CTA ID",
    "Direction",
    "Stop-Street",
    "stop_lat",
    "stop_lon"
]

for keys, group in df.groupby(
    group_cols_for_stops,
    dropna=False,
    sort=False
):
    route, cta_id, direction, street, lat, lon = keys

    observations = []

    for _, row in group.iterrows():
        observations.append({
            "obs": safe_value(row["ID"]),
            "date": safe_value(row["Date"]),
            "actual": safe_value(row["Real Time"]),
            "predicted": safe_value(
                row["Ventra Time (Calculated when previous bus arrives)"]
            ),
            "observationPrevious": safe_value(
                row["Observation Previous (in mins)"]
            ),
            "nextVentra": safe_value(
                row["Observation Next (in Mins), Based on Ventra App"]
            ),
            "actualNext": safe_value(
                row["Actual Next (in Mins)"]
            ),
            "comments": safe_value(row["Comments"])
        })

    route_id = clean_id(route)
    stop_cta_id = clean_id(cta_id)

    stop_records.append({
        "stopId": f"R{route_id}-S{stop_cta_id}",
        "route": route_id,
        "stopName": street,
        "ctaStopId": stop_cta_id,
        "direction": direction,
        "lon": lon,
        "lat": lat,
        "observations": observations
    })

# One row per route-stop-direction, with nested observations
stops = pd.DataFrame(stop_records)

return stops
